messages:
deploy-bot: Starting canary rollout: model=redwood-2026-tokenizer-alpha, env=prod, canary=5% :rocket:
deploy-bot: Release metadata: weights@sha256:abc123, tokenizer=v2+remap, config=tokenizer-remap-enabled
incident-bot: Paging @alice (oncall) — high rate of 502/processing-failures observed on canary. More than 30% error rate over 2m :rotating_light:
alice: on it, jumping in. canary scope and traffic weight?
carla: canary = 5% global, routed to eu-west nodes first. customers: some mid-market chatbots in eu-west.
alice: seeing errors in canary logs, sample: ```
ERROR TokenizationError: Unknown byte sequence at offset 42
  at Tokenizer.map_bytes (tokenizer.cpp:314)
  at Runtime::encode (runtime.cc:102)
  at handler.cpp:45
```
alice: errors correspond to requests that include unicode emoji and long prompt prefixes. not widespread but very noisy.
ben: pulling the model artifact now. quick check: weights hash matches release tag but tokenizer binary in artifact is older (v2-remap missing). might be a build packaging issue where tokenizer artifact didn't get updated.
alice: can we flip a kill-switch or pause routing to that model?
carla: yes, toggling feature flag route.redwood-2026-tokenizer-alpha = off -> fallback to redwood-2025-tokenizer-stable
carla: ```bash
featurectl toggle route.redwood-2026-tokenizer-alpha --state off --reason "canary tokenization errors"
```
deploy-bot: Canary routing change applied: model redwood-2026-tokenizer-alpha traffic -> 0%, fallback model redwood-2025-tokenizer-stable now handling requests.
incident-bot: Notifying downstream systems and metrics pipelines. Latency + error spikes should re-evaluate in 30s.
alice: metrics showing error rate dropped to baseline in eu-west. confirmed immediate mitigation success. :white_check_mark:
ben: downloaded tokenizer artifacts from CI. build log shows tokenizer build step used the wrong artifact path (path remap bug). patch ready in CI to correct path and re-run packaging. estimate 45-60m to produce fixed build and canary.
eva: CS here — any customer-facing impact? we saw a Slack ticket from AcmeApp saying some responses were garbled earlier. they'll want an update.
alice: impact window ~ 00:12-00:20 UTC (approx). affected roughly 5 customers, mostly EU chatbots. errors were mostly malformed tokens and truncated outputs, no data corruption reported. recommend holding canary until fixed.
frank: noted. I'll prepare a short customer blurb for CS to send. eva, will send after we confirm rollback success and a rough ETA for fix?
eva: yes please, we need ETA to tell customers. also will collect any logs/examples from customers.
ben: CI patch merged to fix artifact path. kicking a new build now: `ci/build-tokenizer --target=redwood-2026-tokenizer-alpha`
ben: build started, running unit tests and packaging. I'll watch for packaging step to ensure tokenizer binary v2+remap is present.
carla: we should also add a runtime guard to fallback on tokenization errors instead of bubbling 502s. file a follow-up action.
alice: agree — add pre-parse try/catch + safe-fallback to stable tokenizer as defense-in-depth.
frank: handing off to ben for rebuild+canary verification, I'll own communications (customers + postmortem). ben, please ping here when canary healthy so we can coordinate a controlled rollout.
ben: will do. ETA for canary attempt after new artifact: ~60m, will run a 1% limited canary then ramp.
incident-bot: Incident severity = SEV3 (partial customer impact, mitigated) assigned to alice/ben, follow-up owner = frank.
alice: documenting initial timeline and impact in #postmortems/incidents later today.
carla: quick checklist: 1) feature flag off (done) 2) build fix (in progress) 3) runtime guard ticket (created) 4) customer comms (frank/eva)
ben: new build passed packaging and tokenizer binary present. starting smoke canary at 1% in eu-west.```
deploy-bot: Canary started: model=redwood-2026-tokenizer-alpha, canary=1%
alice: monitoring logs and tokenization error metric.
ben: smoke looks good for 10m now — no TokenizationError hits in canary.
carla: incrementing canary to 5% with close watch, will stop if any regression.
deploy-bot: Canary ramped to 5%
alice: 20m at 5% with no new errors. metrics normal. proceeding to scheduled ramp later if no regressions.
frank: drafting incident summary for customers and internal postmortem. main root cause: packaging path bug caused older tokenizer binary to be included in new model artifact -> token mapping mismatch on certain inputs.
frank: next steps: CI guardrails for packaging path, runtime safe-fallback, and a release checklist update to verify tokenizer artifact version. assigning owners in postmortem.
incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigated) — severity downgraded, monitoring continues for 24h.
alice: handing back to rotations, if any flare-ups ping me.
frank: thanks team. follow-up doc + timeline will be posted to #postmortems later today.
carla: :thumbsup:
ben: good catch on logs, pushing small CI test to prevent regressions.
eva: will notify affected customers and share frank's blurb once ready.
frank: handing to next owner for postmortem edits — @alice and @carla. closing thread.
